{{Quote|Obi-Wan, we want you to take a division of troops to Raxus Prime. We've received reports of Separatist activity in the system.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Raxus system''' was a three-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
[[File:Raxus_system_map.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A map of the Raxus system]]
The Raxus system was home to the junkyard planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Raxus II]], and [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], the capital of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWEG" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] had one [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Raxus (star)|Raxus]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Around [[30,000 BBY]], the system was annexed by the expanding [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], while [[Human/Legends|Humans]] colonized the nearby worlds of [[Barseg]] and [[Janilis system/Legends|Janilis]] via [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] after [[27,500 BBY]]. Following the downfall of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] in [[25,200 BBY]] due to a plague and a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] revolt, the system was briefly ruled by the [[Livien League]]. After circa [[25,120 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Raxus Prime served as a capital for [[Xer VIII]]'s [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] faction&mdash;the [[Kingdom of Cron]]<ref name="Xim Week" />&mdash;before being absorbed by the expansive [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="TEA" />

After Xim's empire collapsed in a [[Xim Wars|war]] with the [[Hutt Empire]] in [[25,096 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Raxus system was briefly ruled by the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> In [[24,000 BBY]], the Tionese [[Tionese War|fought]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along the newly blazed [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], but they joined them a [[23,900 BBY|century later]] after being exhausted by the conflict.<ref name="TEA" />

During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and Galactic Republic, an ancient [[Unidentified navigational probe|navigational probe]] of unknown origins was located in the system. Eventually, someone was sent to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the probe's [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] and discover its origins.<ref name="SLI">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Secrets of the Past}}</ref>
